“The application of a few simple principles can help the mind to keep its balance and function effectively, even when faced with extreme stress.” — from Mindfulness in Plain English by Bhante Henepola Gunaratana. You don’t have to be Buddhist or live a life of meditation (although it helps) but just practicing some mindful principles can help you manage stress as well as anger, anxiety and depression without drugs—or in combination with them which is often very helpful.
